args.title: Issue 4409: change README.md
args.body:
File: README.md

The README.md file contains the 'Running locally' steps that mention MinIO as an option but does not mention the required S3_ENDPOINT environment variable or note that the MinIO bucket must be created first. This omission is the root cause of the issue where uploads go to AWS instead of the local MinIO during local setup.

This omission is the root cause of the issue where uploads go to AWS instead of the local MinIO during local setup.
